title: Light up an area so mobs don't spawn

steps.title: Monsters need dark
steps.say: [Zombies](mob:zombie), [skeletons](mob:skeleton), [creepers](mob:creeper) and [spiders](mob:spider) only spawn where it is really dark. Any light from a torch stops them.

steps.title: Make lots of torches
steps.say: Each [coal](item:coal) and [stick](item:stick) makes 4 torches. [Charcoal](item:charcoal) from burning [logs](item:oak_log) works too.

steps.title: Spread them out
steps.say: Put a torch about every 10 blocks, all over the area. Do not leave dark patches between them.

steps.title: Light caves as you go
steps.say: In caves, put torches on your right as you walk in. On the way out, keep them on your left.

steps.title: Brighter lights
steps.say: [Lanterns](item:lantern), [glowstone](item:glowstone) and [sea lanterns](item:sea_lantern) give even more light, and look nice in a house.

steps.title: A safe place
steps.say: In [mushroom fields](biome:mushroom_fields), monsters do not spawn on the land, even in the dark.
